name: ogbn-papers100M
description: A citation graph derived from the Microsoft Academic Graph (MAG), with about 111 million paper nodes. It is distinct from the smaller ogbn-arxiv dataset. The OGB release uses open terms; this record does not vendor dataset data.
citation: Hu, W., Fey, M., Zitnik, M., Dong, Y., Ren, H., Liu, B., Catasta, M., & Leskovec, J. (2020). Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 33, 22118–22133. (ogbn-papers100M, Papers100M) https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.00687
